summary: Iter60 — My Dezider AI-assess parity tested. 8/9 pytest cases PASSED against the live preview backend; only 1 secondary edge case failed. Endpoint POST /api/decisions/{id}/factors/{fid}/ai-assess correctly returns 400 on missing actual_value, 404 on bad decision/factor/option ids, and 200 with {percentage 0-100, source in ('ai','ratio')} on the happy path. Persistence verified via GET — option.assessments entry contains {factor_id, percentage, unit_value, assessment_mode='custom'} for both main factor and sub-factor (parent_id) variants. GET/PUT regression on /api/decisions/{id} still 200. Frontend source check confirmed: Step7.tsx renders the AI/sparkles TouchableOpacity with testID md-ai-{optionId}-{factorId} (line 454-468), and POSTs to the correct ai-assess endpoint with {option_id, actual_value} (line 326-329). LLM fallback in this run resolved to source='ratio' (dev key budget exhausted), which is one of the acceptable pass states.

minor.issue: When actual_value is omitted and the endpoint reuses the previously-stored option.assessments[].unit_value, the stored value is in the form '<num> <unit>' (e.g. '80 INR'). If the LLM call fails (budget exhausted) the numeric-ratio fallback does float('80 INR') which raises ValueError, so the endpoint responds 502 instead of 200. RCA: backend/routes/decisions.py:247-301 — actual is set to option.assessments[].unit_value (which already includes the unit suffix from line 306: f"{actual}{(' ' + unit) if unit else ''}") and then float(str(actual)) at line 297 fails. Fix: strip unit from stored unit_value before re-using, or persist a separate numeric field, or sanitize actual via re.sub(r'[^0-9.+-]', '', s) before float().

action_items: Minor: harden the 'reuse stored actual_value' branch in md_ai_assess so the numeric-ratio fallback works when the stored unit_value carries a unit suffix (e.g. '80 INR'). Either strip the unit before float-parsing or persist a separate numeric unit_value_raw. Not blocking — primary flow (client always passes actual_value) works.
critical_code_review_comments: decisions.py:306 — option.assessments[].unit_value is stored as a display string with unit ('80 INR'); subsequent numeric-fallback parsing in the same handler can't consume it. Consider keeping a raw numeric alongside the display string.
decisions.py is 1155 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting (ai-assess, xls import/export, CRUD) into sub-modules.

success_rate.frontend: source-verified (no UI run; nested seeded-data flow)

seed_data_creation: Per-module pytest fixture creates TEST_iter60_md_{ts} decision via POST /api/decisions then seeds factors (Cost main + Tax sub-factor with parent_id) and one option (OptA) via PUT /api/decisions/{id}. Cleaned up via DELETE in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary iter60 requirements (400/404/200 happy paths, sub-factor variant, persistence in option.assessments list shape, GET/PUT regression) all pass. The only failing case (test_uses_stored_actual_when_omitted) is an additional edge case I added — it exposes a real but secondary bug in the LLM-unavailable + reuse-stored-actual path. If main agent fixes the float-parse, this test will also pass; otherwise it can be downgraded to xfail. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (https://goals-feels-tracker.preview.emergentagent.com).
rca_of_issue: Symptom: 502 'AI assessment unavailable' on second call when client omits actual_value. Repro: 1) POST ai-assess with actual_value='80' → persists option.assessments[].unit_value='80 INR'. 2) POST ai-assess again with NO actual_value → server reuses '80 INR'. 3) LLM key budget exhausted → falls through to numeric ratio. 4) float('80 INR') raises ValueError → pct stays None → 502. Mitigation: in md_ai_assess (decisions.py:294-301), parse av with: import re; av = float(re.sub(r'[^0-9.+-]', '', str(actual)) or '0'); similarly for ev. Or strip unit at line 250 (actual = (existing or {}).get('unit_value')) before assigning.
